name: The Red Plum Fairy
source:
Paris, 1970. At the renowned Lys de Calla Performing Arts, classic tales are reborn in dazzling performances that capture the city’s gaze.

You play as Marion, a 22-year-old ballerina in her third year with the association. When Fabienne, the prima ballerina that once destined for glory, suddenly withdraws, the coveted role of the Sugar Plum Fairy falls within your reach.  

[From [url=https://717ine.itch.io/the-red-plum-fairy]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
1970年，巴黎。在享誉盛名的马蹄莲表演艺术团里，一部部经典童话在夺人眼目的华丽演出中焕发新生，吸引着全城的目光。

你将扮演22岁的芭蕾舞演员玛丽昂，这已是她加入舞团的第三个年头。当曾被视作明日之星的首席芭蕾舞女演员法比安娜突然退出时，令人梦寐以求的“糖梅仙子”一角顿时变得触手可及。

[摘自[url=https://717ine.itch.io/the-red-plum-fairy]itch.io[/url]]
